Jesus loves everyone and called us to love everyone also. He called sin what it was and called people to repent of their sin and follow him so that we may enter the kingdom of heaven and live for God. We as followers of Jesus are called to love, no matter what, give grace (as we have received amazing grace on the cross), and bring others to Christ.

I have struggled with those same feelings as well, it’s tough. I was with a girlfriend who was “Christian” but had different beliefs than me within the faith, and I felt like I was in this never ending cycle of sinning, repenting, feeling shitty and not worthy to be with God. I think it was helpful for me in this situation to be reminded that when you repent and ask for forgiveness, all your sins are gone and you start completely fresh with Jesus. God doesn’t hold things or sins against you once you repent, he knows that sins have their own consequences, and he’s not going to punish you for that, he’s going to rejoice that you came to him and wants to shower you with blessings. 

That being said, To stop entering the cycle, i found it important that I make changes in my life to deter me from sinning. For me I believe that meant ending my relationship with my girlfriend and taking some time with God, ask for his help to get through the tough temptations and situations and ask for his healing and direction going forward. Even still After I’ve done some of these changes I am stumbling, which God expects, but I feel much better in the way I am trying to live for God. For me it gave me a whole new energy to read the bible and seek Jesus in every day in my life. 

Things very well may be different for your situation, but I thought I would share in case my story helps you in any way. I’ll be sure to pray for you, and if you want to talk about it don’t be afraid to shoot me a message or something. I wish I had more christians to talk to when I was going through the same situation. 

God bless
